blocks.text: Unique materials of this K&H Pet Products Self-Warming Pet Pad heated cat bed utilize and absorb your pet's own body heat, ensuring a nice warm and cozy place for cat naps and dog snoozes. No electricity required! It's the perfect size (21” x 17”) to place on a chair, bed, on cat furniture, in an outdoor cat house, or take with you on the go. Perfect for inside dog and cat carriers on the way to the vet! It's simple to use and is a machine-washable warming pad for easy cleaning. Double-sided with soft material for the option to flip over for a different color on top. Great for cats and small dogs that need a little extra warmth. Designed by K&H with OVER 25 years of experience in creating safe, innovative, quality products for pets; one-year limited warranty.

items.label: SELF HEATED CAT BED TECHNOLOGY
items.value: The unique plush self-warming material captures your pet's body heat and radiates the warmth back to your dog or cat for a cozy warming experience

items.label: NO ELECTRICITY NEEDED
items.value: Heated cat bed safely and naturally keeps your pet warm using their own body temperature to create a comfortable, warm lounging space

items.label: VERSATILE
items.value: Soft, plush, reversible sides to match any décor; measures 21" x 17" that easily fits on furniture, on your pet’s bed, in their crate, or anywhere in your home or on the go

items.label: SLEEP SURFACE
items.value: Soft microfleece top creates a warm, cozy and comfortable, thick and portable cat warming bed that cats and small dogs love

items.label: EASY CARE
items.value: Machine washable cat bed for easy maintenance and convenient cat warming mat

items.label: COLORADO BRAND YOU TRUST
items.value: Designed by K&H with over 25 years of experience in creating safe, innovative, quality products for pets, ensuring safe reliability and top-tier craftsmanship for pet parents; one-year limited warranty

items.label: CRINKLE SOUND
items.value: This pad makes a slight crinkle sound that is attractive to most cats, however it may not be suitable for cats with noise sensitivity

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash, separately. Mild detergents, no bleach. Cold water, gentle cycle. Air or line dry, or tumble dry on lowest setting.
